title: Graph storage: per-node JSONL, daemon owns reverse index
summary: Storage layout: .graph/nodes/{id}.jsonl (one file per task/note, all events including outgoing edges), .graph/checkpoint.json (compacted fold of terminal nodes). No backref events — Y's file never records that X points to it. Daemon builds both forward and reverse edge indexes in memory at startup by scanning all node files. Mirrors git's model: commits know parents, not children; the ref system (daemon) owns reverse lookup. No dual-write, no canonical-vs-informational event confusion. checkpoint.json + node file deletion is the compaction path for terminal nodes.
